verdict.rationale: Folk documents some product-owned background behaviors: automatic import and sync of Google contacts and conversations, and email sequences on a higher plan. These are automations that run without user intervention. However, there is no evidence of a general automation or workflow builder where users define their own triggers and actions. Webhooks and the REST API are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder, documented triggers, schedules and conditions, autonomous AI-agent actions, and any detail or hands-on corroboration of how email sequences run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
